result.evidence: The attached video is a complete 7-minute-and-36-second Manim explainer video on derivatives, starting with an intuitive car speedometer analogy, progressing to secant and tangent lines, limit definitions, f(x)=x^2 calculation, tangent slope plotting, geometric slope-as-steepness interpretation, zooming in to demonstrate non-differentiability of absolute value at zero, and concluding with a review and reflection questions, paired with synchronized edge-tts Chinese narration. Note: Media inspection was performed on the lower-bitrate preview version provided.
